svg.title: Wheel tractor-scraper — Skrapvagn
svg.desc: A powered tractor pulls a broad open earth bowl with a lowered cutting edge between its front and rear wheels.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-wheel-tractor-scraper","label_en":"Wheel tractor-scraper","label_is":"Skrapvagn","section":"01","category_en":"Earthmoving and demolition machinery","category_is":"Jarðvinnslu- og niðurrifsvélar","batch":1,"tags":["earthmoving","scraper"],"description":"A powered tractor pulls a broad open earth bowl with a lowered cutting edge between its front and rear wheels.","design_note":"An open bowl between widely spaced axles differentiates the scraper from a dump truck.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
